study: P5-F MVTec Four-Family Isolated Optimization Study v2
scope: industrial-only MVTec AD development-selection; no medical transfer

gt_free_barrier.official_loader: isolated image-only loader; canonical index/class/image path only
gt_free_barrier.image_preprocessing: RGB, Resize(518,518) bicubic, ToTensor, CLIP mean/std, no augmentation
gt_free_barrier.model_forward: torch.inference_mode, strict FP32, one successful forward per canonical identity
gt_free_barrier.cache_contents: native logits/margins, D_rank, B1 peer IDs/validity/centroid, c [3,1369,8], G upper [3,1369,36]

b1_selector.shared_representation: normalize(mean of the three aligned normalized stage features)
b1_selector.pool: D_rank strictly below within-image median and every stage anomaly percentile strictly below 0.5
b1_selector.ranking: descending shared cosine; ascending patch index tie
b1_selector.invalid_reference: valid_reference=false; peer IDs safe-filled only for computation; B1/family evidence zero; validity separate

common_geometry.c: query-peer cosine, [3,1369,8], normalized FP32 stage features
common_geometry.G: peer-peer cosine upper triangle including diagonal, [3,1369,36]
common_geometry.b1_centroid: normalize(mean eight peer features), then 1-cosine per stage averaged over stages
common_geometry.normalization: raw stage evidence -> authoritative within-image average-tie percentile_rank per component -> frozen family stage aggregation
common_geometry.invalid: zero evidence, candidate_valid=false, coverage diagnostic only

PCRR.formula: peer-relative witness rank; local denominator 8 or pooled denominator 29; mean/median witness and stage aggregation

CSRC.formula: Spearman average-tie or Kendall tau-b inconsistency=(1-association)/2 over all-three or adjacent stage pairs; mean/max pair aggregation

ASR.formula: centered peer Gram eigenspace residual outside subspace; machine-rank/energy-95/energy-99; mean/median stages

PGM.formula: centered peer Gram whitened z_j^2/(lambda_j+eps); sum/max and mean/median stages

selection.rule: gate pass count, direction count, worst normalized margin rank, mean normalized margin rank, lower complexity rank, lexicographically smallest config ID

gates.G4: lower95 C_AP > 0, lower95 R_pos > 0, upper95 R_neg <= 0

multiple_family.test: exact 2^15 paired class sign-flip on OOF matched delta

commit_state_machine.commit1: phase5: freeze MVTec isolated four-family study
commit_state_machine.commit2: phase5: implement MVTec isolated four-family study
commit_state_machine.commit3: phase5: freeze MVTec all-config GT-free evidence
commit_state_machine.commit5: phase5: select MVTec geometry family only if provisional winner exists
commit_state_machine.staging: exact paths only; no git add .; no amend; no force push
